items.title: Jack Kelly Interview, 1963-11-17
items.q: Howard was a guy at the point of time... my daddy converted Howard... Howard used to come to the house for lessons... I was a guy that picked up a lot fast... Howard was pretty good

ctx.x: And, well, he never did get that together. He, you know, so well. But Howard was a guy at the point of time, but he was a drum player. Mm-hmm. And, uh, my daddy converted Howard from a drum player to be a trumpet player because he was young and he had the power, you see.

Yeah. Who was the first one of the two of them that came to the house? Sheik. Sheik came first. Yeah. He was a man. Mm-hmm. Well, when would that have been? How have you been then? Oh, I was around five, six years old. Mm-hmm. You know. What year were you born in 19...
